Walk the pine woods up Corran Ridge
Share lunch in a farm kitchen
Browse the old market on a free morning
sql.itineraries:
Day 1: Arrive in Velmora
Arrive in Velmora and settle into the guesthouse near the old market. In the evening your guide takes you on a stroll along the canal.

Day 2: Corran Ridge walk
Walk up Corran Ridge in the morning through pine woods to the ridge chapel. Lunch is at a farm kitchen, then you return slowly to Velmora.

Day 3: Depart Velmora
Keep the morning free for the market before your transfer to the station.
